spawn_and_init_distributed_processes: spawn multiple distributed processes using torch.multiprocessing.spawn with a temporary file for NCCL initialization
distributed_init_process_group: initialize a torch distributed process group with NCCL backend and set the CUDA device for the given rank
init_and_run_with_group: initialize distributed processes, create a new process group, and run a user-provided function across ranks
test_objects_are_equal_tensors: test whether two PyTorch tensors are equal by comparing their size, dtype, device, and element values
review_objects_are_equal_recursive: review the recursive equality check that supports dicts, lists, tuples, sets, and PyTorch tensors
